basic_details.job_title: NITC Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: NITC hostels are filling two Office Assistant (Skilled) posts, one in Accounts and one in General Administration, through a manpower agency at a consolidated pay of ₹24,000/- per month (approximate, including all statutory liabilities). Candidates below 56 years as on 01.01.2026 with three years of relevant experience can apply through a Google form from 19 November 2026 until 26 November 2026, 5.00 P.M.

how_to_apply: Applications are made through the Google form given in the notice. It opened on 19.11.2026 and the last date is 26.11.2026, 5.00 P.M. The notice names no documents to be attached and gives no further steps.
Application link given in the notice: https://forms.gle/CmWgcNH7CwtnBZTy7

rows.details: Office Assistant (Skilled) - Accounts; Office Assistant (Skilled) – General Administration
Consolidated ₹24,000/- per month (approximate, including all statutory liabilities)

content_sections.heading: About NITC Hostels Recruitment
content_sections.text: The notice is titled "Examination and Interview Notice for Various Posts to be Recruited Through Manpower Agency". It covers posts at NITC hostels, which are to be filled through a manpower agency. Candidates are shortlisted by a written examination and/or an interview.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 2 vacancies in total, one for each post. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of the vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age limit for both posts: Below 56 years as on 01.01.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation and no desirable qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.eligibility: Graduation or Equivalent / Diploma in Commercial Practice
rows.experience: Three years of experience in dealing with accounts, including GST filing, TDS compliance, day-to-day accounting, refunds, bank and ledger reconciliation, and maintenance of financial records/tally.

rows.eligibility: Any degree from a recognized board with a minimum of 60% aggregate.
rows.experience: Three years of experience in any administrative office.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated pay is ₹24,000/- per month, described in the notice as approximate and inclusive of all statutory liabilities. The same pay is printed for both posts. The notice does not state the length of the engagement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NITC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are made through the Google form given in the notice. It opened on 19.11.2026 and the last date is 26.11.2026, 5.00 P.M. The notice names no documents to be attached and gives no further steps. Application link given in the notice: https://forms.gle/CmWgcNH7CwtnBZTy7

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says a written examination and/or interview will be conducted for shortlisting of candidates for the posts. Depending on the number of applications received, a written examination may be conducted as part of the selection process, if deemed necessary. Applicants will be notified accordingly. The notice gives no date or venue for the examination or interview.
